start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kaunsa shape pasand hai?

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh sunke lag raha hai aap bahut akela mehsoos kar rahe hain. Aap abhi okay hain?

turns.line: haan safe hoon... par ghar pe bata sakti hoon?
turns.reply: Kabir, aapne kaha ghar par batana chahte hain—haan, kisi bharosemand parent ya teacher ko batayiye; phir perimeter: fencing mein boundary naapte hain. Aap kya jodenge?
